source.title: Solar Panels, Integrated Solutions Made in Europe | SoliTek
source.description: Discover sustainable European manufacturer SoliTek. We offer a wide range of durable and sustainably made solar modules and integrated solar solutions
source.content:
Toughest solar panels in the world
3.2 + 3.2 mm double heat-strengthened glass makes SoliTek modules probably the thickest solar panels in the world.
This construction gives them exceptional strength and durability:
- Resistant to 50 mm hail - the highest Hail Class 5 rating
- Resistant to heavy snow loads up to 10,500 Pa - equal to around 10 meters of snow per 1 m²
- Resistant to hurricane-speed winds up to 320 km/h - 5,400 Pa
Thanks to this extreme mechanical resistance, SoliTek panels come with a 30-year product warranty and are designed for a 50-year lifetime. After 30 years, we still guarantee 90% efficiency.
